candidate_seeds.idea: nTGC arise first at dim-8 (O(Lambda^-4) interference). The standard form-factor parametrisation is not SU(2)xU(1) invariant; angular distributions of the interference term have a distinctive phi structure in ZZ->4l and Zgamma.
candidate_seeds.signature_hypothesis: phi* angle and m_ZZ / pT_gamma tails; ZZ->4l, ZZ->2l2nu, Z(nunu)gamma, with gauge-invariant dim-8 operators
